select CUST_ID CUST_ID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT CUST_ID CUST_ID2, * FROM
EDS.ATM_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_ID='10471'
UNION ALL
SELECT CUST_ID CUST_ID2, * FROM
EDS.ATM_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_ID='8888'
UNION ALL
SELECT CUST_ID CUST_ID2, * FROM
EDS.ATM_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_ID='5555'
UNION ALL
SELECT CUST_ID CUST_ID2, * FROM
EDS.ATM_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_ID='9999' ) temp order by CUST_ID, SCD_START_DATE


DELETE FROM
EDS.ATM_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_ID='5555' AND SCD_START_DATE='2024-05-13'

UPDATE
EDS.ATM_CUSTOMER SET SCD_END_DATE='9999-12-31' WHERE CUST_ID='5555'
